summary: Comprehensive testing of the Node.js IQ Aptitude MCP server. All backend endpoints (health, MCP auth, initialize, tools/list, semantic search, get_random_question, generate_quiz, check_answer, REST /rest/config, /rest/stats, /rest/sources) validated via pytest — 11/11 passed. Dashboard UI validated via Playwright: stats populated (1 source, 12 questions), MCP endpoint URL populated, sample-aptitude-test.pdf shown as 'ready', semantic search returned 8 result cards, browse returned 12 cards. All acceptance criteria from the review request are met.

issues: The inspector view displays 'Answer: C' beside each question. This is fine for the admin dashboard (data comes from /rest which is admin-facing), but confirm this behavior is intentional — MCP tool responses correctly omit correctAnswer as required.

critical_code_review_comments: Dashboard /rest/questions exposes correctAnswer field in the browse view. Since the app is Bearer-protected only for /mcp (not /rest based on the review context), verify /rest routes are appropriately restricted in production if answers should stay hidden from users.
Consider adding pytest to CI alongside the existing vitest unit/e2e suite for cross-language regression.
context_for_next_testing_agent: MCP endpoint at POST /mcp returns SSE — parse 'data:' line as JSON. Tool result payload is JSON inside result.content[0].text. Bearer token stored as env MCP_AUTH_TOKEN in Node server. Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/test_mcp_backend.py covers all critical flows and can be re-run with: pytest backend/tests/test_mcp_backend.py -v.
